credit_line: American Museum of Western Art – The Anschutz Collection
description: A tan adobe wall stretches across the landscape-oriented canvas. In the center of the wall is a doorway made of light gray wood. Rising above the wall and visible through the doorway is an adobe church with its door open. Inside, the church is bright white. In the courtyard between the door and the church stands a small, pale orange altar with a cross. Rising behind the adobe structures are rolling brown hills dotted with green bushes or trees. A bright blue sky stretches above.
